question: Membership discovery and registration
implementation_answer_excerpt: Public web/referral/QR/event entry; first language selector; accessible introduction, network explanation, short progressive form, verified geography, consent and permanent Person ID. No OTP. Account accessible through secure no-OTP method; save draft and retry; chapters allocated automatically or pending.
owner: Azeez Olayinka (IT Lead), built with Claude
test_evidence: Language first, network by age, five short steps, place, agreement, PIN, permanent Person ID, no OTP. An interrupted registration resumes from a draft held on the server; a repeated send never makes a second account. Chapter is given automatically or the member is pending. STILL OPEN: No QR codes for events; links only. Consent is stored as agreed, without a policy version number.

question: Three referrals
implementation_answer_excerpt: Give unique share link; separately count invitation, registration, verified registration and activation. Recommended milestone is three verified registrations; do not block ordinary membership/community on referral failure. Prevent fabricated/self referrals with automatic checks, provide dispute path.
owner: Azeez Olayinka (IT Lead), built with Claude
test_evidence: Each member has her own link. Opened, registered and completed-seven-days are counted apart. Three is a milestone and blocks nothing. A new member cannot refer herself. STILL OPEN: A dispute goes through the private report lane; there is no dedicated referral dispute screen.

question: Seven-day screening and activation
implementation_answer_excerpt: D1 create profile/welcome; D2 mission orientation; D3 referral introduction; D4 chapter/community introduction; D5 short accessible rule-based self-screening; D6 Institute introduction and auto-reminders; D7 automatic activation if objective mandatory checks pass, otherwise actionable retry/extension/restricted status. No routine human approval/call dependence; audio/text alternative.
owner: Azeez Olayinka (IT Lead), built with Claude
test_evidence: Seven named days, self-screening on day 5, automatic outcome on day 7, more time given automatically. No staff step and no call. STILL OPEN: Question wording awaits decision D09.

question: Membership lifecycle
implementation_answer_excerpt: Status machine: registered, verification-pending, onboarding, self-screening, active, paused/inactive, restricted exceptional, withdrawn. owner: Azeez Olayinka (IT Lead), built with Claude
test_evidence: States shown to the member: registered, on her seven days, active, paused, restricted, withdrawn. She can pause, return, close her membership and see her history. HQ can restore. STILL OPEN: Verification-pending and self-screening are not separate named states. Automated re-engagement messages are not built.
